smartObjectives.target: Design, fabricate, and deploy a low-cost, 3-stream segregation station using upcycled 20L commercial paint drums.
smartObjectives.metric: 1 prototype unit installed in IT Dept corridor.

smartObjectives.target: Achieve a minimum waste diversion rate of 80% away from municipal landfill, and achieve >85% student segregation accuracy.
Utilize locally available scrap materials from campus stores and execute entire fabrication under ₹1,700 within student capabilities.
smartObjectives.metric: Total Expenditure ≤ ₹1,700 with zero expensive workshop machinery.

smartObjectives.target: Align campus waste handling with Solid Waste Management Rules 2016, CPCB norms, and Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation bylaws.
Execute all project phases—from charter initiation to pilot testing and final reporting—within an 8-week academic semester schedule.
smartObjectives.metric: Completion within exactly 8 academic weeks (56 calendar days).

causes: Absence of multi-compartment color-coded receptacles in corridors
Rusted single bins without foot pedals causing hygienic reluctance
Lack of overhead weather canopies protecting receptacles
Absence of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) for housekeeping staff
No scheduled tie-up with authorized AMC recyclers or scrap aggregators
Commingled bags dumped into municipal compactor directly
Proliferation of single-use snack wrappers and PET bottles during break hours
Mass paper discarding during exam submission and lab viva weeks
High moisture canteen food scraps mingling with dry cellulose paper
High general awareness among students but low disposal discipline
Cognitive overload: lack of trilingual Gujarati/Hindi pictorial cues
Absence of peer nudge mechanisms and green student volunteering
Zero prior quantitative data on daily campus waste generation rates
Absence of metrics on contamination or recyclable recovery value
No digital logging mechanism for campus housekeeping
Ahmedabad high summer temperatures (>40°C) accelerating anaerobic odor
Monsoon rainwater intrusion degrading paper recyclability
Stray animal ingress into open corridor dustbins

streams.name: Wet Organic Waste (લિલૉ કચરો)
streams.targetDestination: Campus Aerobic Composting Pit / Soil Conditioning
accepted: Cafeteria food leftovers, rice, rotis, curries
Vegetable trimmings, potato skins, onion peels
Fruit rinds (banana, orange peels, watermelon rind)
Fallen dry garden leaves & grass clippings
streams.handlingProtocol: Empty directly into bin. Operate foot pedal to avoid touching lid. Cleared daily by 4:00 PM for aerobic composting.

streams.name: Dry Recyclable Waste (સુકો કચરો)
streams.targetDestination: Authorized AMC Scrap Recycler / Material Recovery
accepted: Printed A4 assignment sheets, old notebooks, rough papers
Crushed clean PET mineral water & beverage bottles
Aluminium soda cans, clean tin containers
prohibited: Greasy food-stained pizza boxes or oily samosa wraps
Used tea paper cups with sugary liquids
streams.handlingProtocol: Ensure items are dry and clean. Flatten cardboard cartons and crush PET bottles to conserve volumetric capacity.

streams.name: Non-Recyclable Rejects / Inerts (નકામો કચરો)
accepted: Multi-layer metallized chip packets (Lays, Kurkure wrappers)
Wax-coated candy wrappers, soiled thermal receipts
Corridor sweeping dust and inert grit
Broken ceramic mugs, degraded non-recyclable laminates
prohibited: Clean white paper or corrugated boxes
Biodegradable food scraps or wet organic waste
Lead-acid or lithium dry cell batteries
streams.handlingProtocol: This represents the sole stream destined for municipal landfill collection. Aim to minimize daily mass.

streams.name: Domestic Hazardous & E-Waste (જોખમી કચરો)
accepted: Spent AA/AAA dry cell batteries, button cells
Fused LED/CFL bulbs and fluorescent tubes
Broken laboratory glassware, discarded chemical containers
streams.handlingProtocol: Handle with puncture-resistant nitrile gloves. Store in secure, locked bin prior to hazardous pickup.

auditLogs.notes: Peer volunteers placed near kiosk during tea break.
Student briefing conducted in IT Dept lecture hall.
Bilingual signage QR placards verified functional.
First compost turning; added 500g dry neem leaves.
Saturday lab session; clean assignment paper collected.
End of week 1 audit; diversion rate climbed to 82%.
Week 2 kickoff. High adherence among Sem-V students.
Crushed PET bottle bin utilization increased.
Zero foul odor in wet bin; bio-enzyme spray applied.
Final pilot day: 88.5% Diversion Rate, 92% Segregation Accuracy.

risks.description: Cross-Contamination of Bins (e.g., wet food thrown into blue dry recyclable bin)
risks.mitigation: High-contrast bilingual pictorial signage; foot-pedal color coding; daily morning spot-checks by team leads.
risks.contingency: Deploy student peer volunteers during peak tea hours (11:00 AM - 1:00 PM).

risks.description: Student & Staff Apathy / Behavioral Resistance to Waste Segregation
risks.mitigation: Classroom awareness campaign; visual infographics mounted at eye level (1.5m); gamified green recognition.
risks.contingency: Conduct 5-minute interactive awareness talk during departmental student club meetings.

risks.description: Foul Odor & Fruit Fly Infestation in Wet Organic Waste Bin
risks.mitigation: Tight-fitting spring lid; mandatory daily clearing by 4:00 PM; periodic spray of diluted citronella/bio-enzyme.
risks.contingency: Transfer wet waste twice daily if corridor temperatures exceed 38°C.

risks.description: Anaerobic Putrefaction & Foul Leachate in Pilot Aerobic Composter
risks.mitigation: Maintain optimal 30:1 C:N ratio using crushed dry neem leaves; turn compost twice weekly for aeration.
risks.contingency: Add dry shredded cardboard and coco-peat immediately if moisture exceeds 65%.

risks.description: Vandalism, Accidental Damage, or Physical Station Displacement
risks.mitigation: Station bolted securely to heavy timber skid; installed in CCTV-covered corridor opposite faculty rooms.
risks.contingency: Quick-swap spare hinges kept in IT Dept hardware locker.

risks.description: Paint Chipping or Adhesion Failure on Polyethylene (HDPE) Buckets
risks.mitigation: Surface pre-abraded using 120-grit emery sandpaper; synthetic anti-corrosive primer cured 12 hours prior to enamel.
risks.contingency: Touch-up spray cans stored for on-site maintenance.

risks.description: Failure or Unreliability in AMC Authorized Scrap Recycler Handover
risks.mitigation: Pre-negotiated verbal agreement with licensed local AMC aggregator; secure dry departmental storage room.
risks.contingency: Secondary backup aggregator roster maintained across University Road area.

risks.description: Monsoon Rainwater Ingress Causing Paper Spoilage & Base Rot
risks.mitigation: Overhead sloped canopy (5° pitch); elevated base skid raised 150 mm on anti-corrosive rubber pads.
risks.contingency: Relocate station 2 meters deeper into enclosed corridor alcove during intense storms.

risks.description: Accidental Needle/Glass Injury or Pathogen Exposure to Waste Handlers
risks.mitigation: Mandatory heavy-duty puncture-resistant nitrile gloves, N95 dust masks, and hand-tongs (no open bare-hand sorting).
risks.contingency: First-aid antiseptic kit and tetanus immunization verification in place.

risks.description: Budget Overrun due to Unforeseen Consumable Purchases
risks.mitigation: Strict 10% contingency reserve (₹152) pre-allocated; wholesale purchases from verified hardware vendors.
risks.contingency: Substitute any non-essential vinyl graphics with hand-stenciled enamel.
